message.content: The row-building loop already supports creating rows from column data. I’ll change only validation and test both sequential column addition and length mismatch.

*** End Patch

apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tests/test_prettytable.py
@@
 class TestDeleteColumn:
+    def test_add_column_to_empty_table(self) -> None:
+        table = PrettyTable()
+        table.add_column("City", ["Adelaide", "Brisbane"])
+        table.add_column("Area", [1295, 5905])
+
+        assert table.rows == [["Adelaide", 1295], ["Brisbane", 5905]]
+
+    def test_add_column_with_mismatched_length_raises_error(self) -> None:
+        table = PrettyTable()
+        table.add_column("City", ["Adelaide", "Brisbane"])
+
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Column length 1 does not match number of rows 2"):
